title: Wanstead Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical locations, urgent treatment centres, and hazard guidance for Wanstead and Snaresbrook.
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 first. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: Whipps Cross University Hospital, Whipps Cross Road, Leytonstone, London E11 1NR (from Snaresbrook station: ~20 min walk west along Snaresbrook Road and Whipps Cross Road, or bus 66 or W12). For designated Major Trauma care, the regional centre is The Royal London Hospital, Whitechapel Road, London E1 1FR (from Wanstead station: Central line west to Mile End, then District or Hammersmith & City line to Whitechapel). 2. Urgent Treatment Centres: Whipps Cross Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre, Whipps Cross Road, Leytonstone, London E11 1NR (located at the main hospital entrance on Whipps Cross Road; accessible via bus W12 from Wanstead High Street). 3. Area Hazards: The River Roding borders the eastern boundary of Wanstead, creating flood risk along Eastern Avenue (A12) and Wanstead Park waterways. Open grasslands at Wanstead Flats and Wanstead Park present seasonal grassfire risks during prolonged dry heatwaves. 4. Supplies: Pharmacies and supermarkets along Wanstead High Street can provide bottled drinking water, first-aid materials, and essential medicines during prolonged outages. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
